title: Post–Phase AG commit gate

verdict_rationale: No behavioral regression vs pre-AG. Ops route table SHA256 and count are byte-identical to pre-AG. URL/controller/middleware mappings unchanged. EnterpriseTestRunner 53/53. Observed module HTTP failures (CRM/recruitment missing controller classes; POS e2e fixture env; bare /pos 404) are pre-existing and unchanged by AG — CRM already failed in Phase AD with the same Arabic error page.

performance_vs_pre_ag.note: Faster only; not a functional regression
